context: R36 installed candidate Direct-DPI Start failure after candidate parity and UI smoke passed

failure.error: One or more parameter values passed to the method were invalid.

rootCause: PowerShell expression @(@($Dns1,$Tpl1)) flattened the intended single resolver pair into two System.String elements. foreach therefore indexed characters: first iteration passed ServerAddress='7' and DohTemplate='6' to the Windows DoH cmdlet, causing invalid parameter values.
prevention: Removed nested-array pair iteration entirely for the single resolver.
Added regression assertions forbidding foreach($pair), $pair[0], and $pair[1] in Direct-DPI start.
Candidate installer rebuilt under source-freeze guard.
